name: American University of the Middle East (AUM)
tests: High-school average (certified by the Kuwait Ministry of Education): 70% (2.5) science section for engineering and technology; 60% (2.0) for business. AUM English Skill Assessment Test minimum 40% for all colleges, plus a Math Skill Assessment Test.

name: Canadian University Dubai
tests: Non-UAE curricula taught in English: IELTS Academic 5.0 / TOEFL iBT 61 / ITP 500 (Creative Industries: IELTS 5.5 / iBT 71). IELTS Online and TOEFL Home Edition not accepted. Math placement test unless SAT Math 450+ or 70% UAE maths; 80% in English for UAE curriculum applicants.

name: American University in Dubai (AUD)
tests: English: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 79 (TOEFL ITP 550) for full admission; IELTS 6.0 / iBT 68 / ITP 520 gives admission with a developmental English course. Math proficiency by SAT or AUD placement test (SAT code 2688). IB/A-level/AP can exempt you from tests. Application fee AED 420; AED 5,000 seat deposit on acceptance.

name: Alfaisal University
tests: International applicants submit transcripts sent directly by the school, passport, financial documentation and English/aptitude scores as listed on the OISE page. Application fee SAR 600.

name: Rochester Institute of Technology Dubai (RIT Dubai)
tests: High-school transcript; English test (IELTS, TOEFL or EmSAT) if available; maths and physics placement tests (SAT Math scores can place you). Engineering needs 80% in maths and two sciences.

name: Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University (TSU)
tests: Georgian citizens: Unified National Exams. Foreign citizens or Georgians educated abroad: document review, with an exam or interview if the faculty requires it; English-taught programmes require an English level certificate. Then recognition of your school certificate by the National Center for Educational Quality Enhancement and a Ministry of Education decree.

name: Yerevan State University (YSU)
tests: Armenian applicants take national unified exams; international applicants are admitted through YSU's procedure for foreign citizens (most teaching in Armenian, some in English/Russian).

name: International Christian University (ICU)
tests: Minimum English: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 79. SAT/ACT/IB are not required minimums; ICU publishes average scores of successful applicants (2022-2026). All documents are weighed equally.

name: The British University in Egypt (BUE)
tests: Admission follows Egyptian Council of Private Universities rules plus BUE criteria. American-diploma applicants: minimum SAT1/EST1 800 or ACT 14 (EST2 900 for subject tests), and 520 in SAT/EST English; school transcripts stamped by the relevant ministries.

name: Georgian Technical University (GTU)
tests: Foreign citizens: online registration, consent letter from GTU, recognition of foreign education by the National Center for Educational Quality Enhancement, then a rector's order completes enrolment and visa documents are issued. Foreign-language (English-taught) programmes are listed on GTU's admissions site.

name: German University in Cairo (GUC)
tests: Teaching is in English and all students also study German. Contact GUC for certificate-specific requirements for international applicants.

name: African Leadership University (ALU)
tests: Secondary certificate with minimum passes (e.g. Rwanda ACSE 50% overall or equivalent); application guide lists country-specific equivalents.

name: Al Akhawayn University in Ifrane
tests: Applicants whose language of instruction was not English must submit IELTS or TOEFL; placement writing tests in Arabic, French and/or English.

name: American University of Armenia (AUA)
tests: Holistic admission. SAT (code 7257), ACT (6982), TOEFL iBT (4151) and IELTS Academic accepted; AUA entrance exams can be waived for strong test results or international olympiad medallists. International admits also need final approval from Armenia's education ministry (fs.emis.am).

name: Bocconi University
tests: Admission test required: Bocconi Online Test, SAT or ACT. English-taught programmes require an accepted English certificate (B2 or higher, e.g. IELTS or TOEFL).

name: CUQ Ulster University (City University Qatar)
tests: No SAT/ACT needed; admission is based on school-leaving results. English: IELTS or equivalent.

name: Carnegie Mellon University in Qatar
tests: Whether SAT/ACT is needed depends on your curriculum and intended major. English: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo required unless waived; see CMU-Q's English proficiency page for minimums.

name: Community College of Qatar (CCQ)
tests: No SAT/ACT needed; admission is based on school-leaving results. English: placement testing for English and maths.

name: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies
tests: No undergraduate entry; SAT/ACT does not apply. English: needed for some programmes; most teaching is in Arabic. Bachelor's degree with GPA 3.0+ (final-year students may apply).

name: Free University of Tbilisi
tests: Georgian Unified National Exams; contact the university about entry for foreign citizens.

name: Georgetown University in Qatar
tests: Check GU-Q's current SAT/ACT policy for your cycle; strong scores support an application. English: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo for non-native speakers.

name: HEC Paris in Qatar (Doha)
tests: No undergraduate entry; SAT/ACT does not apply. Executive MBA admission is based on professional experience, interviews and HEC's own assessment.

name: Ilia State University
tests: International applicants to English-taught programmes need CEFR B2 English (international certificate, a medium-of-instruction letter, or Ilia's online B2 test). Programme entrance exams (English, maths, physics, biology or chemistry) may be held online via Zoom. Application fee USD 150 after preliminary approval (can be waived if you handle recognition yourself).

name: International Black Sea University (IBSU)
tests: English: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 78, or other recognised B2 certificate. Documents: notarised passport copy translated into Georgian, school certificate and transcript for recognition by the national agency (handled by IBSU's international office).

name: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
tests: No undergraduate entry; SAT/ACT does not apply. English: official TOEFL/IELTS score required before enrolment unless your degree is from the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia or NZ; no waivers.

name: Kutaisi International University (KIU)
tests: All bachelor's programmes are taught in English, so applicants must show English proficiency. Georgian citizens are admitted through the Unified National Exams; foreign citizens follow the KIU procedure for international applicants (see the "For Foreign Citizens" page).

name: Lusail University
tests: No SAT/ACT needed; admission is based on school-leaving results. English: required for English-taught programmes (or placement test).

name: Nazarbayev University
tests: NUET (NU's own entrance test) or SAT accepted for many programmes. English: IELTS 6.5 or equivalent (foundation year for lower scores).

name: New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD)
tests: SAT/ACT optional. English: no separate English test is normally required; strong English is shown through the application — check current guidance. Finalists are invited to a Candidate Weekend in Abu Dhabi.

name: Northwestern University in Qatar
tests: SAT/ACT accepted and superscored; check whether scores are required for your cycle. English: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo for non-native speakers.
